resolution.note: ship, pr body and lane run take the base from the repo contract

title: krn pr ship and pr body target the repo contract base branch
body:
Why: krn pr ship pushes against main only (src/ci/ship.ts:60,128,165,172,190 and src/cli/pr-body.ts:81 base 'origin/main'); krn lane run on a contract with base master refuses before the session (src/cli/lane-run.ts goal and task modes).
Outcome: krn pr ship and krn pr body take the base branch from the repo contract (src/repo/contract.ts contractBase); lane run ships on any base.
Proof: ship unit test on a fixture whose origin default branch is master: PR opens with --base master and the rebase target is origin/master.
Scope: src/ci/, src/cli/pr-body.ts, src/cli/lane-run.ts, test/.
